subject: Panel closure: Zeno (SWE, IC5) — reconcile scores & next steps
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sarah Patel <sarah@hireflow.co>
Date: Fri, 2 Oct 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Panel closure: Zeno (SWE, IC5) — reconcile scores & next steps

Hi all,

Thanks again for interviewing Alex ("Zeno") earlier this week. I collected the preliminary scorecards and put the consolidated PDF and raw notes in the Drive link below. We have a split on the system-design section (Jonas 4 / Marissa 2) and different takes on leadership impact — so we need a quick reconciliation before I send the hiring recommendation to People Ops.

Proposal: two options 
- Quick async reconciliation: can each of you drop a 1–2 line justification for any score that differs from the median by >=2 points in the Drive doc by EOD Monday? I can synthesize and call the result.
- Short sync (15m): tomorrow 10/3 at 10:30am PT to land consensus.

Please indicate preference and add comments to the "panel_notes-20261002.txt" attachment if you pick async. If we pick sync, I'll send a calendar invite.

Attachments: zeno_full_scorecards.pdf, zeno_resume.pdf, panel_notes-20261002.txt

Drive: https://drive.example.com/drive/folders/0B1-zeno-debrief
Greenhouse: https://greenhouse.example/candidates/zeno-1294

Thanks — Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Staff Recruiter (Hiring Program Lead)
Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Oct 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Panel closure: Zeno (SWE, IC5) — reconcile scores & next steps

I can do async. Quick note on my system-design score: 4 because Alex proposed a sharded key-value design that accounts for tail latencies and offered a concrete retry/backoff strategy compatible with our KV cache. Also liked the latency/cost trade-off comments. Will add a 2-line rationale into the Drive file.

—Jonas
Senior Staff SWE, Backend

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Oct 2026 16:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Panel closure: Zeno (SWE, IC5) — reconcile scores & next steps

Async works for me too. My shorter rationale: lower system-design score (2) because the design left out failure modes around long-tail GPU cloud cold starts and didn't address model warmup/caching explicitly. I noted a suggested mitigation (warm pipelines) but didn't feel it was part of the candidate's answer. I'll paste the note into the panel_notes file.

Marissa
Engineering Manager, Serving Runtime

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 3 Oct 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Panel closure: Zeno (SWE, IC5) — reconcile scores & next steps

I did a quick pass in the Drive. For leadership/impact I put a 3 with the note that Alex showed good cross-team thinking but didn't demonstrate prior ownership at scale. I'm comfortable with an offer if we include a hiring bar that the role pairs with a senior-level PM for the first quarter and a clear onboarding milestone.

Also — Mina, can you confirm the coding rubric subtotal? I'm seeing a 4 vs 5 discrepancy between your sheet and the consolidated PDF.

Grace
Sr. Engineering Manager, Platform

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 3 Oct 2026 10:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Panel closure: Zeno (SWE, IC5) — reconcile scores & next steps

Thanks — I fixed a small transcription error in the consolidated PDF (coding subtotal should be 5; I had mis-typed a field when exporting). Updated PDF attached and pasted a one-line justification next to any score that differed by >=2.

Given the updated totals, my recommendation: extend an offer at IC5 with the onboarding milestone Grace suggested and a 6-month performance checkpoint. I'll tag the comments in the Drive doc so Tessa can assemble the final note to People Ops.

Mina
Staff SWE, Inference Runtime

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 4 Oct 2026 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Panel closure: Zeno (SWE, IC5) — reconcile scores & next steps

Appreciate the quick turn. Summary — updated and agreed: coding 5, system-design median 3 (Jonas' clarifying notes acknowledged), leadership/impact 3. Action items: 
- I will submit the Hiring Recommendation to People Ops with the attached rationale + onboarding milestone and a 6-month checkpoint.
- Marissa please draft the IC5 role expectations paragraph (2–3 bullets) for the offer packet by EOD Monday.
- Sarah (cc'd) — once POps approves, do you have the candidate's flexibility for start-date windows next week?

I'll archive the final PDF in the candidate folder. If anything changes, flag here.

Thanks — Tessa
